title: Life Domain
html:
Life Domain is one of the Subclasses of Cleric. These Clerics are more specialized in preserving life, and their healing spells are more potent.

Player-selectable deities associated with this domain include  Bahamut,  Corellon Larethian,  Eilistraee,  Helm,  Ilmater,  Lathander,  Selûne, and  Yondalla.

“
Tasked with the holy edict of preserving the body, mind, and soul, your god grants you a plethora of healing magics.
„

Subclass features

This subclass obtains all the features from its base class, Cleric, in addition to its unique features outlined below.

Level 1

  • Gain  Heavy armour proficiency
Disciple of Life
Your devotion empowers your healing Spells. When casting a healing spell, the target regains additional hit points equal to 2 + the spell's level⁠⁠hit points.
Domain Spells
You gain spells from your domain. They are Always Prepared.
  •  Bless 
  •  Cure Wounds

Level 2

 Preserve Life ( + )
Evoke a healing energy that restores 3 × Character level⁠⁠Hit Points to allied creatures.

Level 3

Domain Spells
You gain spells from your domain. They are Always Prepared.
  •  Aid
  •  Lesser Restoration

Level 5

Domain Spells
You gain spells from your domain. They are Always Prepared.
  •  Revivify
  •  Beacon of Hope 

Level 6

Blessed Healer
Healing others heals you as well. When you cast a healing spell of Level 1 or higher on another creature, you regain hit points equal to 2 + the spell's level⁠⁠hit points.

Level 7

Domain Spells
You gain spells from your domain. They are Always Prepared.
  •  Guardian of Faith
  •  Death Ward

Level 8

 Divine Strike: Radiant ()
Strike a foe with your weapon as it becomes wreathed in gleaming radiance. ( Recharge: Per turn.)

Level 9

Domain Spells
You gain spells from your domain. They are Always Prepared.
  •  Greater Restoration
  •  Mass Cure Wounds
